response.sql: WITH group_counts AS (SELECT ReportsTo, COUNT(*) AS employee_count FROM Employee GROUP BY ReportsTo), shares AS (SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, employee_count * 1.0 / SUM(employee_count) OVER () AS share, 1.0 / COUNT(*) OVER () AS average_share FROM group_counts) SELECT ReportsTo, employee_count, share, share - average_share AS share_difference FROM shares ORDER BY share_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
